Create Easy, Robust, Low-Cost Online Exams

Get your own, white-labelled Online Exam Platform, usable on any device by your Students, Staff & Admin

2 Million+ Exams taken — Get Started with your own Exam Platform today!

New Exam Platform
All Question Types

MCQs (Single & Multi-correct), Numerical Qs (Integer, Decimal, Calculator), Subjective Qs (Upload Images or Type responses), Coding Qs (Python, Java, C++)

Capacity & Concurrency

EZexam is a cloud-based system, can support any number of Users at the same time and create any number of Student Accounts

Top Institutes

Vidyalankar Classes & Resonance use EZexam. 2 Million+ Exams taken - 2.3 Million+ Questions added - 300,000+ Student Accounts created in the last 3 years

Your own Customized Portal & WebApp

Your white-labeled web platform is created at institute-name.ezexam.in with your Logos and Colors where your Students & Staff have user accounts. Can add your own Exam Types, Centres & Classes and assign Students to them. Faculty can be assigned to Students to monitor them.

Customized WebApps can be installed from your platform on Mobile devices, and they are also white-labeled with your Name, Logo & Colors. These WebApps function as fully native applications and run in full screen mode to reduce distractions during exams.

Your EZexam platform can even be hosted on your own web domain, contact us for more details

"Get your own custom web platform to conduct exams & manage students"

Multi-Device & Slow Internet Support built-in

Exams can be taken on Any Device, PC/Laptop, Android & iOS Smartphones, Tablets. On Mobile devices, a WebApp is automatically created, and exams are taken through it. WebApp is customized with your Logo & Colors and is downloadable from your platform.

EZexam is built to be extremely tolerant to Bad Internet. Essentially, Students need to ensure they have a connection when starting the Exam & when Submitting the exam, EZexa
